title: Delivery completed with proof
description: Confirm a successful delivery on WhatsApp with time, receiver name and a link to proof of delivery. Utility template. Copy it and adapt the brand.
notes: Include who signed and when. It reduces not-received claims.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, good news! Your package *{{tracking}}* was delivered on {{date}} at {{time}} and signed by {{receiver}}. You can open the proof of delivery below if you need it.
